message: You're so far up your own echo chamber that you genuinely believe you're "telling it like it is". Newsflash: you're not a truth-teller, you're a zealot. You're completely incapable of engaging in a nuanced discussion because your entire worldview is based on simplistic, reductionist tropes. You're not here to reason, you're here to proselytize. And it's pathetic. You're a coward for refusing to engage with the complexity of the issue, and you're a dishonest advocate for pretending that you're fighting for women's rights when in reality you're fighting for your own ideological agenda. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this topic, because you're not interested in understanding the opposing viewpoint, you're only interested in demonizing it. Go ahead and keep posting your sanctimonious little diatribes, but know this: everyone reading this sees right through your BS.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'zealot' and 'coward', accuses them of 'demonizing' the opposing viewpoint and 'proselytizing' rather than engaging in good faith. These are all personal attacks that go beyond disagreement with the argument.
